title: Birth, father in Fisher's band, first teacher Rag Baby Stevens
summary: Hazel gives his birth date and place, says his father was a bass drummer in Fisher's Ragtime Military Jazz Band, and names Rag Baby Stevens as his first teacher and the Rex parade as his first job.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: What would you like to turn off your name if you like, Arch?
Well, my name is Arthur Frank Hazel. I was born in Harvey, Louisiana. That's just across from Louisiana Avenue in New Orleans.

August the 15th, 1903. My father was a bass drummer in one of the early jazz bands of New Orleans. It was called Fish's Ragtime Military Jazz Band. And my first teacher was Rag Baby Stevens. And my first job was in the carnival parade. In those days the only parade that had any jazz in it at all was the Rex parade, which was a union. The only union parade of all the parades.
